_readme: Clicks over the 7 days before measuredAt (read-only SQL on prod analytics_events). `clicks`: event go_link_click, grouped by properties->>'slug'. `outClicks`: event gift_out_click (every Shop click on the gift guides, holiday audit D H2, first recorded from this change), grouped by properties->>'link' (host + path, no query), rows with properties->>'automated' left out. Read by scripts/gift-guide-picks.mjs for the landing's Top 10 This Week; a pick's clicks rank it first, then commission x popularity. Re-measure before a train.
